caption: The drawing features a large rectangular wooden table positioned centrally, rendered in a reddish-brown color with two wide pedestal legs that curve outward for support; the table has distinct grain lines suggesting wood texture. Arranged along one side of the table are six wooden chairs, each with a slatted backrest and slightly flared legs, matched in the same reddish-brown color as the table. Behind and around these central colored objects are various technical sketches and measurements drawn in thin, precise lines. These sketches include side views, top views, and sections of the table and chairs, complete with labeled dimensions such as the table's height, the width and shape of the legs, and the seat and backrest dimensions of the chairs. Details such as the beveled edges, positioning of braces, cross supports, and spacing between boards are specified, with measurements given in inches. The background is a light, neutral tone, and the technical sketches are monochromatic, typically shown in gray or black outlines without color fill.
title: Shaker Dining Table and Chairs
